in_marathi.name: Satyen
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truthful and Pure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Satya' (truth) and 'Indriya' (senses). Satyen signifies one who is truthful and pure in thoughts and actions.

in_bengali.name: Satyen

in_bengali.long_meaning: Satyen একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Satya' (truth) and 'Indriya' (senses). Satyen signifies one who is truthful and pure in thoughts and actions.
